## Two-step equations

Solve each equation. Show each step. Check your answer.

::: {.problems cols="2"}
- $3x + 5 = 20$ | 5 | 3x = 15, x = 5
- $2x - 7 = 11$ | 9 | 2x = 18, x = 9
- $4x + 6 = 30$ | 6 | 4x = 24, x = 6
- $5x - 4 = 21$ | 5 | 5x = 25, x = 5
- $x/3 + 8 = 12$ | 12 | x/3 = 4, x = 12
- $7x + 2 = 37$ | 5 | 7x = 35, x = 5
:::

{{< pagebreak >}}

## One-step equations

Solve. Write the inverse operation you used, then the answer.

::: {.problems cols="3" style="dots"}
- $x + 9 = 17$ | 8
- $x - 6 = 11$ | 17
- $4x = 36$ | 9
- $x / 5 = 7$ | 35
- $12 = x + 4$ | 8
- $3x = 27$ | 9
- $x - 2.5 = 4$ | 6.5
- $8x = 56$ | 7
- $x / 3 = 9$ | 27
:::
